method.dropout: exact random removal of available positive-weight metrics per company
method.data_quality: recomputed from perturbed coverage when component breakdown is available
method.rank_correlation: Spearman with average ranks for ties
method.policy_comparison: Every policy uses identical metric-dropout samples.

baseline.label: A - production baseline
baseline.mechanism: Current renormalization of available metric and group weights.

coverage_penalty.label: B - bounded coverage penalty
coverage_penalty.mechanism: Subtract up to 20 points in proportion to missing designed weight.

coverage_caps.label: C - coverage rating caps
coverage_caps.mechanism: Keep the baseline score and cap ratings below experimental coverage bands.
